intro.heading: Start With the Exposure, Not the Catalogue
paragraphs: Buying training by the course usually produces a schedule that satisfies a budget line and misses the actual risk. We start the other way round: what would hurt this organisation, who is in a position to prevent it, and what is the smallest programme that changes their behaviour.

For most organisations that means awareness and phishing drills for everyone, one technical track for the team that builds or runs the systems, and a leadership briefing so the people funding the programme understand what they are funding. Certification tracks come in when there is a specific compliance driver.

Programmes are quoted per cohort rather than per head, so training the whole team costs the same as training half of it. That is deliberate: per-seat pricing is why organisations train the people who can spare the time rather than the people who need it.

items.title: On-Site Cohorts
items.description: At your office anywhere in India. Best for leadership briefings, tabletop exercises and any session where the discussion between attendees matters as much as the content.

items.title: Live Online
items.description: Same instructor, same exercises, cohorts of up to 40 for awareness and 16 for labs. Suits distributed teams and avoids losing a day to travel.

items.title: Self-Paced Modules
items.description: For shift workers, field staff, new joiners and anyone a scheduled session never reaches. Delivered through your LMS or ours, with completion records either way.

items.title: Blended Programmes
items.description: A live core session, self-paced reinforcement, and quarterly drills. This is what most annual programmes settle into after the first cycle.

items.title: Train the Trainer
items.description: For larger organisations running internal delivery: your facilitators are trained on our material and licensed to deliver it, with content updates included.

items.title: Executive Briefings
items.description: Ninety-minute sessions timed to fit a board or leadership meeting, delivered on your agenda rather than requiring a separate diary slot.

tailoring.heading: What We Tailor
tailoring.intro: Tailoring is included in cohort pricing rather than charged as an extra. Generic material is the single biggest reason training gets ignored.
items: Screenshots and walkthroughs using your actual systems and tools
Phishing pretexts drawn from your sector, region and calendar
Labs built in your language, framework and cloud platform
Scenarios rebuilt from your own incidents and near-misses
Policy references pointed at your documents, not generic examples
Regulatory content scoped to the obligations that apply to you
Delivery in English or Hindi, with other languages on request

items.title: Attendance and Completion
items.description: Per-employee records exportable as CSV, structured for an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 evidence pack without reformatting.

items.title: Assessment Results
items.description: For certification tracks, results and certificate references per delegate, with verification codes your HR team can check.

items.title: Behavioural Metrics
items.description: Click rate, report rate and time to first report from phishing drills, trended across the year rather than reported per campaign.

items.title: Management Summary
items.description: A one-page view after each cycle: what moved, what did not, which teams need attention and what the next cycle should target.

items.title: LMS Integration
items.description: Self-paced material delivered as SCORM packages into your existing LMS, or hosted by us if you would rather not run one.

items.title: Data Handling
items.description: Delegate data is processed under a defined retention period, individual phishing results are never published internally, and a processing agreement is signed before any data moves.

commercials.heading: How Engagements Are Bought

faqs.question: What is the minimum engagement?
faqs.answer: A single cohort. Plenty of organisations start with one awareness session or one tabletop exercise, see whether the approach lands, and build a programme from there. We would rather you started small than committed to an annual plan on a first conversation.

faqs.question: How much notice do you need?
faqs.answer: Three to four weeks for a tailored cohort, because tailoring means reading your material and rebuilding examples. Untailored delivery can move faster. Tabletop exercises need longer — usually four weeks — since scenario design depends on reviewing your plan first.

faqs.question: Can you train staff outside India?
faqs.answer: Yes. Live online cohorts run across time zones, and we deliver on-site outside India where travel is justified by the group size. Regulatory content is scoped to the jurisdictions that actually apply to your entity.

faqs.question: Do you work with our existing LMS?
faqs.answer: Self-paced material is delivered as SCORM packages that drop into most systems, and we have delivered into Moodle, Microsoft Viva Learning and several commercial platforms. If your LMS is unusual, we will test a package before you commit.

faqs.question: What if training is not actually the answer?
faqs.answer: We will say so. If people are clicking links because there is no email filtering, or bypassing a process because the process is unusable, more training will not help. That conversation happens at scoping, and it sometimes ends with us recommending a consulting engagement instead of a cohort.
